question: Should Meridian Roast switch its oat-milk supplier, and to whom, and why?

claims.text: Evidence-based answer (8 verified claims). Top finding: Golden State Oats is the cheapest qualified option at $2.87/unit (MOQ 800L, 4d lead, 6% contract discount); the incumbent Oatly West (distributor) lists at $3.42. All claims below link to their source rows.
